crypto.generation: Before first device request privately persist three independent 32-byte random secrets (64 lowercase hex): device_secret, runtime_secret, lifecycle_secret. Never print them.
crypto.commitment: lowercase hex SHA256 of UTF-8 secret string (NOT decoded bytes and NOT full prefixed token).
crypto.runtime_token: aeon_<runtime_prefix>_<runtime_secret>. Existing auth hashes secret component only. Server returns prefix, never secret.
crypto.proof: device_secret redeems only the initiating request. Separate lifecycle_secret reads and acknowledges only own lifecycle/tombstone; never general APIs. Both travel only in JSON HTTPS body.

integration.workspace: tenant_id is Aeon workspace; workspace_path is local folder. Both immutable approval inputs.
integration.polling: 5 seconds minimum, honor 429 Retry-After; bounded request lifetime 10 minutes; verification expiry fixed at request +30 minutes.
integration.accounts: One explicitly chosen account per harness per request, at most four; account IDs and daemon ID returned by server must replace local guesses.
integration.verification: Created atomically exactly once on approval, using existing work-order/run/allowance machinery. Daemon consumes ordinary queued runs; must honor server-provided harmless task and duration. Never create runs from setup retry.
integration.drain: Immediately fence dispatch/reservation/claim; allow only already-active telemetry settlement. Reconcile/self/get completes drain once no active runs remain.
integration.revoke_now: Immediate server fence; full removal revokes runtime key. Local processes remain unconfirmed and cleanup pending. Device proof permits tombstone reconciliation only.
integration.selective: A removed enrollment cannot be probed, reserved, claimed or resurrected by manual registration; other accounts keep working.
integration.metadata: Server provisions metadata. Paired daemon skips PUT metadata (account.manage); probe uses account.probe, route account.route, list account.read.
integration.ongoing_limits: Connect only followed by existing separately authenticated person allowance UI/API. New non-verification window explicitly enables ongoing execution; runtime cannot create it.
integration.add_harness: Same device endpoint with existing_computer_id and existing_lifecycle_secret. Fresh request_id/device_secret and explicit person approval; identical original runtime_hash/lifecycle_hash/workspace/computer details. Adds new accounts to same daemon/principal without rotating healthy runtime key. Old revoked enrollments remain tombstones.

run_projection.purpose: pairing_verification on immutable verification run, managed otherwise
run_projection.verification_task: Reply exactly AEON_VERIFIED. Do not modify files, perform privileged actions, access external networks, or use external/MCP tools. Use the enforced read-only verification mode.
run_projection.verification_policy: read_only (no blanket claim all tools disabled)

integration.offline_cleanup: After observed local exit, lifecycle proof may acknowledge safe owned cleanup while retaining immutable pending usage journal locally. Server keeps active run/reservation accounting unconfirmed, never settles via proof.
integration.run_errors: Existing claim/telemetry error envelope retains error field containing stable pairing code; pairing and account endpoints additionally return code.
integration.setup_command: verified absolute binary path setup --url configured origin --workspace approved absolute folder --state-root private absolute folder outside repos --harness chosen harness --start-service; default tenant slug from guide
integration.installation: PAIR4 exact official GitHub inspr-at/paimos release artifact and SHA256SUMS (OCI image inspr-at/aeon is a different repository). Verify exact filename before executable permissions. Install only into new versioned user-owned directory; refuse existing destination and Nix/existing tool. Crossbuild target is not service qualification.
integration.distribution_evidence: Read-only gh release view v260927160212.0.0 --repo inspr-at/paimos verified current macOS arm64/amd64, Linux amd64 and SHA256SUMS artifact URLs. Linux arm64 is a candidate added by PAIR4 for the forthcoming release.

verification_capabilities_contract.approval: one_per_harness with any unsupported selected account returns HTTP 409 code verification_unavailable, no grants/accounts/runs created. Person must explicitly choose connect_only or exclude that account; no silent downgrade. Existing identical approvals remain idempotent.
verification_capabilities_contract.progress: Reconcile progress accepts state=connected,error_code=verification_unavailable. Enrollment projection uses verification_state=unavailable and verification_error=verification_unavailable only for unclaimed queued unsupported verification; does not change computer authority/connectivity or infer process death.
verification_capabilities_contract.expiry: Unclaimed queued verification is cancelled and its owned reservation released transactionally at expiry under tenant claim/lifecycle fence. Claimed live/uncertain work is never expired this way. No replacement run/allowance/refill.
verification_capabilities_contract.implementation_seam: internal/agentpairing/capabilities.go verificationCapabilities(platform, arch). Empty platform/arch means conservative global guide. PairingView and approval use immutable request platform/arch; RunFence and VerificationTargets dispatch use the same function. Future darwin-only qualification can be added here after root supplies evidence; no capability widening via client input.
